[!cgo] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1

# Accept: the .lgo spelling maps the call to the fast path.
mkdir $WORK/obj-ok
go tool cgo -objdir $WORK/obj-ok -importpath example.com/fast ok/f.lgo
grep '^\t_cgo_runtime_cgocall_fast\(' $WORK/obj-ok/_cgo_gotypes.go

# Reject: a marker with an extra field stays on the plain path.
mkdir $WORK/obj-arity
go tool cgo -objdir $WORK/obj-arity -importpath example.com/fast arity/f.lgo
! grep '^\t_cgo_runtime_cgocall_fast\(' $WORK/obj-arity/_cgo_gotypes.go
grep '^\t_cgo_runtime_cgocall\(' $WORK/obj-arity/_cgo_gotypes.go

# Reject: a marker outside the preamble is an inert comment.
mkdir $WORK/obj-nonpre
go tool cgo -objdir $WORK/obj-nonpre -importpath example.com/fast nonpre/f.lgo
! grep '^\t_cgo_runtime_cgocall_fast\(' $WORK/obj-nonpre/_cgo_gotypes.go
grep '^\t_cgo_runtime_cgocall\(' $WORK/obj-nonpre/_cgo_gotypes.go

# Reject: a marker with no matched C function fails.
mkdir $WORK/obj-ghost
! go tool cgo -objdir $WORK/obj-ghost -importpath example.com/fast ghost/f.lgo
stderr 'no matched C function'

-- ok/f.lgo --
package fast

/*
#include <stdint.h>
//logos:cgo_fastcall ladd
int ladd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- arity/f.lgo --
package fast

/*
#include <stdint.h>
//logos:cgo_fastcall ladd extra
int ladd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- nonpre/f.lgo --
package fast

/*
#include <stdint.h>
int ladd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"
//logos:cgo_fastcall ladd

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }

-- ghost/f.lgo --
package fast

/*
#include <stdint.h>
//logos:cgo_fastcall ghost_fn
int ladd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

func Add(a, b int32) int32 { return int32(C.ladd(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }
